records.title: Early Exit with Disentangled Representation and Equiangular Tight Frame
records.reason: The primary paper does provide a real early-exit efficiency method, but its tested backbones are BERT-base, ALBERT-base, and multilingual BERT on classification/regression NLP tasks, not generative LLMs or LLM serving. This is an adjacent PLM-classification result rather than a clear match to the stated scope.

records.title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation
records.reason: MUSE-Autoskill develops a self-evolving skill lifecycle for LLM agents; its abstract focuses on agent capability and management rather than reducing inference cost.

records.title: LongLive-2.0: An NVFP4 Parallel Infrastructure for Long Video Generation
records.reason: LongLive-2.0 is a video-generation system; although it optimizes that workload's inference, its model is a video generator rather than an LLM.

records.title: Assessing the carbon footprint of language models: Towards sustainability in AI
records.reason: No abstract was supplied in the candidate packet; the primary DOI landing could not be accessed during screening. The author-affiliated TU Graz publication record contains an abstract, but does not provide the primary article body used for this screen.

records.title: ReasonEdit: Towards Reasoning-Enhanced Image Editing Models
records.reason: ReasonEdit improves image-editing model reasoning using an MLLM encoder; the abstract describes image-editing quality, not LLM inference efficiency.
